channel.description: 2026-09-07 当天筛选出的 AI × 物理 / 化学 / 材料交叉文献 RSS。

item.title: Multi-task deep-learning optimization of trade-off properties for superior-performance Fe-based soft magnetic alloys
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Kang-Yuan Li, Mao-Zhi Li, Wei-Hua Wang
提出生成式多任务深度学习框架，同时优化铁基非晶合金成分、饱和磁通密度、矫顽力与玻璃形成能力。该方法可在数据有限且不均衡时共享任务信息，预测并生成满足目标性能的新合金候选。

item.title: Hessian-based molecular conformation augmentation for a scalable and efficient strategy of machine learning interatomic potentials
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Bumju Kwak, Jeonghee Jo
arXiv:2609.05233v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: While machine-learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) have successfully learned potential energy surfaces (PES) and atomic forces, many practical applications, such as vibrational analysis and transition state search, rely heavily on the PES Hessian. Yet, standard MLIPs tend to be trained on energy and forces alone, leaving Hessian information largely unexploited. Meanwhile, existing methods that explicitly incorporate the Hessian into training objectives require architectural modifications and introduce significant computational and memory overheads due to higher-order backpropagation. To address these limitations, we propose two Hessian-derived data augmentation schemes: isotropic Gaussian displacement (UniAug) and normal mode-weighted d…

item.title: FluxDisco: Symbolic Regression for Stoichiometric Dynamical Systems via Monte Carlo Graph Search
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Cassandra Durr, Alvaro Köhn-Luque, Chris Jewell, Lloyd A. C. Chapman
提出面向化学计量通量型 ODE 的物理信息符号回归框架 FluxDisco，将已知化学计量关系用于缩小表达式搜索空间并保持物理一致性。结合蒙特卡洛图搜索，可从含噪数据中恢复可解释的动力学方程。

item.title: Data-Driven Discovery of Composition-Dependent Constitutive Models for Hyperelasticity and Viscoelasticity of Digital Materials
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Josué García-Ávila, Beijun Shen, Manuel K. Rausch, Mary C. Boyce, Adrián Buganza-Tepole
提出面向多材料数字材料的数据驱动本构建模框架，在保留经典模型运动学与耗散结构的同时学习组成相关参数和演化规律。多速率压缩数据表明，该方法能描述不同组成中的速率相关刚度与滞回，并保持热力学一致性。

item.title: Disentangling Attention in Deep Operator Learning: A Controlled Study of Data-Driven and Physics-Informed Architectures
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Amar Alem Koric, Qibang Liu, Seid Koric
通过受控比较五类 DeepONet 注意力结构，系统分离交叉注意力、自注意力、标记化和注意力深度的影响。传感器级标记化结合交叉注意力在全部基准中降低误差，整体上是最稳定有效的机制。

item.title: A Unified Physics-Aware Quantum Machine Learning Framework across Power GaN HEMTs and Logic Nanowire FETs: Predicting Unseen Process Splits and Held-Out Geometry Combinations with Lower Error and Tighter Split-to-Split Variability
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Rushat Rai, Yun-Yuan Wang, Autsada Kakaen, Pei-Jie Chang, Doan Viet Nguyen, Yuan-Chieh Chiu 等13位作者
提出结合 GNN、PPO 与 LOGOCV 的统一量子机器学习框架，用于数据稀缺条件下的 GaN HEMT 和纳米线 FET 建模。其在 11 个目标上均取得最低 MAE，并降低误差及跨折波动。

item.title: Unveiling wing turbulence dynamics through explainable deep learning
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Samuel Molina-Casino, Andrés Cremades, Sergio Hoyas, José I. Cardesa, François Chedevergne, Ricardo Vinuesa
利用深度神经网络预测机翼湍流演化，并通过 Shapley 归因识别关键流动区域。研究发现，靠近后缘时预测重要性由近壁低速结构转向成对的三维高速与低速区域，为传统结构分类之外的湍流组织与控制提供线索。

item.title: A Data Fusion Framework for Grounding Aerospace Surrogate Model via Experimental Wind-Tunnel Observations
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Nitin Nagesh Kulkarni, Dheeraj Vemula, Yin Yu, Peter Lyu, Juan J. Alonso
提出利用风洞 PSP 测量校正 CFD 训练气动代理模型的方法，无需重新训练或修改原代理参数。基于有限实验数据，校正模型在保留泛化能力的同时改善表面压力预测，在留出攻角上的误差为实测 Cp 范围的 2.3%至2.7%。

item.title: Voltage-embedded equivariant machine learning potential for open system simulations
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Yiming Guan, Rongzhi Gao, ChiYung Yam, GuanHua Chen, Ziyang Hu
arXiv:2609.04696v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Modeling electrochemical interfaces under operational non-equilibrium conditions is vital for energy technologies but remains bottlenecked by the expensive cost of ab initio methods. Current machine learning potentials, largely designed for closed systems under homogeneous electric fields, are limited in open quantum transport applications. To overcome this, we present an E(3)-equivariant graph neural network that embeds voltage bias for open-system simulations. Our approach decouples the system energy and forces into zero-bias and bias-dependent contributions, assigning distinct vector encodings to electrode and scattering-region atoms to capture non-equilibrium conditions. Trained on limited discrete bias data, the model achieves high pr…

item.title: 利用 Quantum ESPRESSO 计算 DFT 自旋—轨道溢出
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Duy Quan Nguyen, Paul C. H. Li
本文介绍了如何从晶体结构计算自旋—轨道溢出（spin-orbit spillage），该量可用于衡量材料具有拓扑特征的可能性，也是相关机器学习分类器所依据的参考量。作者以绝缘化合物 BaMg2Bi2 为例，使用 Quantum ESPRESSO 分别进行包含和不包含自旋—轨道耦合的计算，并通过波函数重叠分析得到溢出值 2.094，与已发表的 VASP 结果 2.075 相差 0.9%。文章还讨论了相对论赝势的作用以及该流程在半金属中的局限性。

item.title: Large Language Models for HVAC Operations in Building Energy Systems: A Critical Review of Methods, Applications, and Deployment Readiness
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Alexander Neubauer, Tianzhen Hong, Han Li, Mengbo Yu, Amin Darbandi, Yannick Fürst 等7位作者
系统评述 2023年至2026年3月间 66 篇 LLM-HVAC 研究，发现仅 4 篇达到试点级证据，尚无持续运行部署案例。现有证据更支持 LLM 作为语义与工作流层，点名规范化、文档支持和物理控制器辅助等用途值得近期试验。

item.title: 基于互信息的量子策略梯度流程时间表达性与可训练性估计指标
item.description:
📚 Machine Learning: Science and Technology
👤 Jaehun Jeong, Donghwa Ji, Kabgyun Jeong
近年来，传统监督学习的局限性推动了强化学习及量子强化学习的发展。本文针对强化学习的时间动态，将表达性重新定义为时间表达性，并证明动作分布与离散化奖励信号之间的互信息为缩放梯度范数提供上界，同时给出时间表达性指标的信息论分解和考虑残差的上界。在明确的集中性假设下，作者进一步建立了基于互信息的时间表达性与可训练性度量，并将其用于初始化阶段梯度脆弱性的一侧预筛选。

item.title: Physics-Informed Dual-View YOLO Framework for Tennis Ball Trajectory Prediction
item.description:
📚 Preprints
👤 Hsu-Chun Huang¹, Qing-Wei Zheng, Kawuu W. Lin, Wei-Ting Lin
提出融合双视角观测、YOLO 定位、三维运动重建和 Magnus 效应的网球轨迹预测框架。引入 Magnus 耦合后，Z 轴 MAE 从 2.49 米降至 1.08 米，总体 RMSE 从 2.82 米降至 1.52 米。

item.title: AxQM: A Textbook-Scale Benchmark for Formal Proof Synthesis in a Library of Finite-Dimensional Quantum Mechanics
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Weichen Winston Yin, Jacob M. Taylor, Dirk R. Englund, Frank H. L. Koppens
发布 AxQM 形式化证明综合基准，包含来自 Nielsen 与 Chuang 教材 479 个条目的 1019 个 Lean 内核可检验证明任务。所有任务均保证存在解，并由 Lean 内核确定性检查证明有效性、无 sorry 及无新增公理…

item.title: Learning Memory-Dependent Neural Network Correlation Potentials for Accurate Electron Dynamics
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Harish S. Bhat, Christine M. Isborn
arXiv:2609.04527v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Time-dependent density functional theory, though exact in theory, is in practice applied in an adiabatic approximation using exchange-correlation functionals with only local temporal dependence. Simultaneously, the exact correlation potential formally depends on, among other quantities, the time-history of electron densities. Here we develop a framework to learn neural network models of correlation functionals that feature explicit memory-dependence. Our framework includes two different approaches, both linked through their use of adjoint-based optimization. One approach decouples the learning of the functional from inversion to find ground truth values of the correlation potential. The other approach learns the functional directly without r…

item.title: On-board ML for Trace Gas detection in Imaging Spectroscopy data
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Vít Růžička, Adam Chlus, Andrew Thorpe, David R. Thompson
在 2026 年东京野外试验中，利用 AVIRIS-5 成像光谱数据开展机载边缘机器学习处理。该小型高效模型无需立即下传完整数据立方体，即可首次在机上检测到成像光谱甲烷点源排放。

item.title: 通过迭代回溯蒙特卡罗采样引导蛋白质语言模型中的序列生成
item.description:
📚 Machine Learning: Science and Technology
👤 Francesco Calvanese, Gianluca Lombardi, Martin Weigt, Jorge Fernandez-de-Cossio-Diaz
蛋白质语言模型利用大规模进化数据生成新序列，但在保持多样性的同时使生成结果趋向目标理化性质仍然具有挑战性。本文提出无需训练的迭代回溯蒙特卡罗采样方法，在自回归延伸与 Metropolis—Hastings 精化之间交替进行，以近似从兼顾生成质量和引导目标的最大熵分布中采样。理论与实验结果表明，该方法在相同生成质量下具有更高的样本多样性，并能改善目标分子性质；在分类器引导、家族特异性蛋白质语言模型和 ProGen3 上也得到验证。

item.title: Disentangling Internal and Forced Climate Variability with Convolutional Neural Networks using Multivariate Fields
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Guillaume Gastineau, Elena Provenzano, Constantin Bône, Nicolas Lebas, Robert C. J. Wills
采用 U-Net 从 1950年至2022 年多模式集合数据中分离气候强迫变率与内部变率。对局地月平均地表气温强迫变率的误差为 0.1至0.4°C，优于四阶多项式趋势方法，但对降水和海平面气压的表现较弱。

item.title: Evidence Integration in Large Language Models
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Sebastien Kawada, Manolis Kellis
提出大语言模型证据整合的分布理论，并在逾千万次试验、12 个模型和 8 个领域中验证其预测。研究表明，模型更易接受与自身分布相符的候选，即使已内部验证其错误，仍可能将其整合进最终答案。

item.title: LLM-Assisted Behavioural and Scenario Augmentation for Agent-Based Energy Adoption Models
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Iias Faiud, Hossein Khaleghy, Michael Schukat, Karl Mason
提出将有界行为规则与结构化情景规格嵌入校准型主体模型的混合框架，用于爱尔兰奶牛场光伏采纳分析。多政策、蒙特卡洛世界和随机种子实验显示，行为影响稳定且可解释，采纳率最高可较逻辑模型增加约 13%。

item.title: Anharmonic Lattice Dynamics and Anisotropic Electron-Phonon Coupling in Quasi-1-Dimensional Charge Density Wave Ta2NiSe7
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Prithwija Mandal, S. Nanthini, Aditya Singh, Kewal S. Rana, Dibyendu Dey, Kanishka Biswas 等7位作者
arXiv:2609.05129v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The microscopic origin of charge density wave formation in quasi one dimensional Ta2NiSe7 remains actively debated, particularly regarding the relative contributions of Fermi surface nesting, electron phonon coupling, and lattice instabilities. Here, we combine temperature and orientation dependent polarized Raman spectroscopy with first principles calculations to uncover the anisotropic electronic and lattice interactions governing the CDW state in Ta2NiSe7. Heat capacity and electrical transport measurements identify an incommensurate CDW transition at 61 K. Raman spectroscopy reveals pronounced in plane anisotropy, with e ph coupling strength along intrachain b axis exceeding five times that along interchain c axis, whereas lattice anharm…

item.title: Cross-Layer Anomalous Hall Transport driven by Néel-Vector rotating in the Altermagnet candidate V2Te2O
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Yanan Pan, W. Z. Zhuo, Pan Gao, Ziyu Zhou, Junqing Xu, Lijie Shao 等10位作者
arXiv:2609.05085v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In van der Waals (vdW) materials, weak interlayer coupling generally suppresses vertical dispersion, reinforcing the conventional paradigm that in-plane transport dominates over cross-layer channels. Here, using first-principles calculations and magnetic symmetry analyses, we uncover a giant, symmetry-unlocked cross-layer anomalous Hall conductivity (AHC) in the vdW altermagnet V2Te2O. In the magnetic ground state with Neel vector N//z, horizontal mirror symmetry protects a spin-polarized nodal chain near the Fermi level and strictly enforces zero anomalous Hall response. Tilting the Neel vector explicitly breaks this mirror protection, allowing spin-orbit coupling to gap the nodal chain and activate a sharp cross-layer Hall response. When t…

item.title: A locally ab initio computational framework for arbitrary incommensurate materials interfaces
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Drake Niedzielski, Tomás A. Arias
提出适用于任意非公度材料界面的局域第一性原理电子结构框架，利用 Wannier 哈密顿量矩阵元的近邻性进行跨层配位插值。该方法无需巨大公度超胞或莫尔近似，并在 30°扭转双层石墨烯中重现实验谱特征及预测准周期平带。

item.title: Local coordination, structural softening, and polarization-switching energetics in Sc-alloyed GaN
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Shailesh Kalal, Gueorgui Kostov Gueorguiev, Martin Magnuson, Edward Ferraz de Almeida Junior, Rohini Sanikop, Sagar Jathar 等11位作者
结合 X 射线谱学与第一性原理计算，揭示 Sc 掺入 GaN 后局域配位增加、键长增长且四面体不对称性减弱。随 Sc 含量升高，极化翻转势垒由 24.2 降至 19.0 meV/Å³，d₃₃ 由 2.99 增至 12.46 pC/N。

item.title: Energy Eigenstates of Electrons, Magnons and Phonons in Fe₃O₄ (magnetite), MnFe₂O₄ (jacobsite), and mixed Mn-Zn ferrites
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Deepak Dhariwal, Michael R. von Spakovsky, William T. Reynolds Jr
arXiv:2601.16374v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We report first-principles calculations of the electronic structure, magnon excitations, and phonons in magnetite (Fe₃O₄), jacobsite (MnFe₂O₄), and mixed manganese-zinc ferrites (Mnₓ,Zn₁₋ₓ)Fe₂O₄ for representative compositions (0le x le 1) and A/B-site cation arrangements. Electronic structures are computed using density functional theory (DFT) augmented by rotationally invariant DFT+U+J, with on-site Hubbard and Hund's parameters, U and J, respectively, determined self-consistently by spin-polarized linear-response perturbations of the chosen correlated subspaces (including, where applied, the ligand 2p subspace). item.title: Robustness of RKKY interactions across a Weyl node-annihilation transition
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 João V. F. Alves, Joelson F. Silva, Luis G. G. V. Dias da Silva
推导任意二维自旋晶格体系的完整 RKKY 交换张量，并研究其跨越 Weyl 节点湮灭转变的行为。交换耦合的空间分布、强度和各向异性结构保持稳定，表明短程和中程相互作用受整个价带的全局量子度规控制。

item.title: Generalized Helicity-Dependent Magnetization Switching via Substrate Phonons
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 F. G. N. Fennema, H. Damas, H. Yoshikawa, A. Tsukamoto, C. S. Davies, A. Kirilyuk
比较六类点群、不同红外横光学声子对基底介导磁化翻转的影响，发现所有测试基底均出现螺旋度依赖切换。切换峰值通常短波移于横光学声子共振，说明效率由异质结构整体光学响应而非基底吸收单独决定。

item.title: Spin-Point-Group Classification of Multipoles for Nonrelativistic Collinear Magnets
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Yuuki Ogawa, Satoru Hayami
完成对 32 个非磁性和 122 个共线自旋点群中活性轨道与自旋多极矩的系统分类。所得数据库区分结构与磁性贡献，联系多极矩和响应张量，并识别无需自旋轨道耦合即可存在的非相对论响应。

item.title: Demonstration of room-temperature, magnetic-field-free, and ultralow-power spin-orbit torque logic device based on composition-uniform van der Waals magnet Fe3GaTe2
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Zhengxiao Li, Qianbiao Liu, Wenliang Zhu, Lijun Zhu
arXiv:2609.04600v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Van der Waals magnets have received blooming interest in material science and spintronics for the advantages of low magnetization, flexible stacking, strong tunability, and dangling-bond-free interfaces. However, there has been no report of room-temperature magnetic-field-free spin logic device based on a van der Waals magnet. Here, we demonstrate a room-temperature, field-free, low-power, scalable spin-orbit torque in-memory computing logic device utilizing a van der Waals magnet Fe3GaTe2 bit with strong perpendicular magnetic anisotropy and a Pt channel with strong spin Hall effect, high electrical conductivity, and electric asymmetries. Current pulse width-dependent switching measurement reveals a low intrinsic critical magnetic-field-fre…

item.title: Breakdown of Anomalous Hall Scaling in Dilute Kondo System
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Arnab Bhattacharya, Prashant Singh, Ajay Kumar, Afsar Ahmed, Yaroslav Mudryk, I. Das 等7位作者
在稀释 Kondo 合金 Ru₂Mn₀.₅Ti₀.₅Ge 中观测到本征 Berry 曲率驱动的反常霍尔输运，其响应在磁转变附近呈非单调并在 Kondo 相干形成后恢复。第一性原理计算表明，平带、Kondo 杂化与自旋轨道耦合共同形成费米能级…

item.title: Challenges in orbital current-driven domain wall motion in light metal/ferrimagnet heterostructures
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Min-Gu Kang, Jaerin Kim, Benjamin J. Jacot, Laura Van Schie, Pietro Gambardella
arXiv:2609.04811v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Recent advances in spintronics suggest that orbital Hall currents generated by charge injection in light metals can provide nonequilibrium angular momentum without relying on strong spin-orbit coupling (SOC). Here, we examine whether such orbital currents can drive domain wall (DW) motion in an amorphous ferrimagnetic alloy, Gd₂₅(Fe₉Co₁)₇₅ (GFC), where the rare-earth sublattice offers strong SOC for orbital-to-spin conversion. We compare three representative heterostructures: Pt/GFC as a spin Hall reference, light-metal (Mn or Ti)/GFC for direct orbital-current injection, and light-metal/Pt/GFC incorporating an ultrathin Pt layer for orbital-to-spin conversion. Whereas Pt/GFC exhibits robust and reproducible spin-orbit-torque-driven DW motio…

item.title: Excitation caging in a vertex-frustrated quasiperiodic Einstein artificial spin ice
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 T. Wang, F. Museur, G. M. Macauley, J. Colbois, L. Berchialla, F. Flicker 等8位作者
在 Hat 铺砌构成的爱因斯坦人工自旋冰中，磁力显微与蒙特卡洛模拟揭示了两阶段部分有序过程。基态流形中每个 antihat 恰有一个被囚禁激发，但整体仍宏观简并，形成准周期长程结构与受约束无序叠加的中程有序。

item.title: Ni-O hybridization as a stabilizer for s± superconductivity in La₃Ni₂O₇: a DFT+RPA study
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Lauro B. Braz, Daniel D. Rivera, Emmanuel V. C. Lopes, George B. Martins, Gustavo M. Dalpian, Luis G. G. V. Dias da Silva
DFT+RPA 研究表明，保留宽能区 Ni–O 杂化的全谱模型会增强层间自旋涨落并产生公度磁不稳定性。该机制倾向于稳定变号 s± 超导态，而低能模型则更倾向 d 波配对。

item.title: Exact quantum spin liquids with topological order on maple-leaf and trellis lattices
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Li Ern Chern, Roderich Moessner, Claudio Castelnovo
arXiv:2609.04319v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We construct spin models with bond-dependent anisotropic interactions on the penta-coordinated maple-leaf and trellis lattices, which yield exact Z₂ quantum spin liquids akin to the Kitaev honeycomb model. We characterize the resulting ground states by their flux sectors, Chern numbers, and topological excitations. Using replica exchange quantum Monte Carlo simulations, we find that the gauge fluxes are ordered at sufficiently low temperatures such that every unit triangle has ± π/2-flux, where the sign is uniform across the system, and every unit hexagon (square) has 0-flux (π-flux) within the parameter space of interest. 通过第一性原理计算研究 Mn、Y 修饰氮掺杂碳纳米带的储氢性能。平均吸附能分别为 −0.40 和 −0.25 eV/H₂，0 K 理论质量储氢容量达 7.48%和 6.55%；在 30 atm、298.15 K 下，Mn 体系仍保持 7.4…

item.title: Accelerating Atom Simulations with Variable-Block Sparse Matrix Library
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Zhanghao Zhouyin, Hong Guo
arXiv:2609.04397v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Modern atomistic simulations increasingly employ localized orbitals to represent quantum operators, yielding sparse block matrices whose block shapes vary with chemical species and basis choice. Conventional scalar sparse formats store the entries of each block individually, obscuring this local structure and limiting the use of efficient block algorithms. We present VBCSR, a distributed sparse matrix library that preserves variable-size atomic blocks and accelerates the core linear algebra of large-scale atomistic simulations. A unified interface automatically maps scalar, uniform-basis, and multispecies operators to compressed sparse row (CSR), block sparse row (BSR), or variable-block compressed sparse row (VBCSR). Our advanced accelerati…

item.title: Band Gaps and Localization of Surface Waves at Hyperbolic Material and Topological Insulator Interfaces
item.description:

arXiv:2604.08091v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: ZnTe is arguably the most widely used nonlinear crystal for the generation and detection of THz radiation, used in conjunction with sub-bandgap optical excitation by femtosecond lasers operating near 800 nm. The THz dielectric function of ZnTe is the key parameter defining the efficiency and bandwidth of THz generation and detection. Here, we demonstrate that the THz dielectric function of ZnTe undergoes substantial transient modification at 800 nm sub-bandgap excitation under conditions typical for THz generation. These modifications arise from significant free-carrier generation via two-photon absorption of the 800 nm pump, accompanied by the pump-driven activation of the THz-active phonon modes.
